capabilities: Create flashcards manually or load them via JSON or JS
Run quizzes from commands, menu icons, placeholders or inline markdown blocks
Track streak, repeated cards and daily quiz counts
Display month, year and card progression charts
disambiguation: Despite the name suggesting simple quizzes, the README describes a spaced-repetition flashcard system with statistics and charts.
extras: README title says 'Spaced repetition using flashcards' while the plugin is named Simple Quiz; detailed docs on markdown blocks, groups and examples are linked elsewhere. JS card loading must be enabled in settings; a TODO lists planned card types and image support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create flashcards or run quizzes with spaced repetition and progress tracking.
summary: Flashcard plugin that runs spaced-repetition quizzes from manually entered cards, JSON or JS definitions, with stats and charts.
